Question Choices: A snail crawls 1/6 of a meter in 1/2 of a minute. What is its speed in meters per minute? (Enter as a fraction or decimal) Give an exact fraction or a decimal rounded to the nearest thousandth.
Hints: Divide the amount by the time or other input; multiply by the reciprocal of the divisor.
Solution: (1/6) ÷ (1/2) = (1/6) × 2 = 1/3. The quotient is the amount per one unit of the denominator quantity. Check: rate × the original time/input recovers the original amount. Exact calculation: (1 ÷ 6) ÷ (1 ÷ 2) = 1/3. Rounded to the nearest thousandth: 0.333.

Question Choices: What percent of 60 is 21? (Enter only the number)
Hints: Divide part by whole, then multiply by 100.
Solution: 21 ÷ 60 = 0.35 = 35%. Percent means per hundred: part ÷ whole × 100. Calculation: 21 ÷ 60 × 100 = 35. Enter 35, the percent number.
